aiAssistant.title: Smart Assistant
aiAssistant.enableHelp: Allow trusted local AI clients to query data and manage campaign files through controlled MCP tools. Off by default; disabling stops the service independently of official services.
aiAssistant.disabled: Smart Assistant is disabled. Enable it in Settings → Feature management.
aiAssistant.security: Loopback only; never starts automatically. The token permits local data access and file-changing campaign activation/switching: share only with trusted clients. Switching an active campaign requires confirmation; restore/uninstall require native Electron confirmation every time.
aiAssistant.rotateWarning: Regenerating immediately invalidates all existing client credentials. Update your client configuration.
aiAssistant.historyHelp: Only the latest 500 safe metadata records are kept in memory, without request parameters. Stopping preserves history.
aiAssistant.error.generic: Operation failed. Check the service status and port, then retry.
aiAssistant.error.AI_ASSISTANT_INVALID_P: Port must be an integer between 1024 and 65535.
aiAssistant.error.AI_ASSISTANT_PORT_IN_U: Port is already in use. Choose another port and retry.
aiAssistant.error.AI_ASSISTANT_START_FAI: Service could not start. Check the port and retry.
aiAssistant.tokenHelp: Start the service, then show or copy credentials for a trusted AI client. Leaving this tab hides the token.
aiAssistant.capabilitiesSafety: 12 controlled tools: activation changes files directly only when conflict-free. Switching an active campaign requires one native Electron confirmation naming current→target, then separate restore and activate steps; restore may succeed while target activation fails. Restore/uninstall require native Electron confirmation every time and are denied without an available window. Review file conflicts manually in the existing UI. No arbitrary shell commands, arbitrary file access or starting downloads.
aiAssistant.limit.pagination: Pagination: limit (integer) defaults to 20 (1–100); offset (integer) defaults to 0 (0–100000).
aiAssistant.description.get_app_status: Check the application and local game configuration status.
aiAssistant.description.get_campaign_det: View an installed campaign using its local identifier.
aiAssistant.description.list_downloads: View summaries of visible local download tasks.
aiAssistant.description.get_task_status: Check the progress and status of a known local download task.
aiAssistant.mutationData: Mutation queries use local data; optional backend calibration is available only when both official services and weekly mutation calibration are enabled.
aiAssistant.description.activate_campaig: Activate an installed campaign directly only when conflict-free, changing game files.
aiAssistant.description.switch_campaign: With an active campaign, confirm current→target once natively, then restore and activate separately; restore may succeed while target activation fails. With none active, activate directly only when conflict-free.
aiAssistant.description.restore_campaign: Deactivate and restore original files. Native confirmation each time; review conflicts in the existing UI.
aiAssistant.description.uninstall_campai: Uninstall an installed campaign. Native confirmation each time; review conflicts in the existing UI.
aiAssistant.description.list_mutators: Search local mutators and browse paginated details.
aiAssistant.description.get_weekly_mutat: View local weekly mutation information for a region.
aiAssistant.limit.mutators: Optional search (string) ≤100 characters; limit (integer) defaults to 20 (1–100), offset (integer) to 0 (0–100000); language (string): zhCN/enUS/ruRU/koKR/frFR/deDE, default zhCN.
aiAssistant.limit.weeklyMutation: region (string): CN/NA/EU/AS, default CN; language (string): zhCN/enUS/ruRU/koKR/frFR/deDE, default zhCN.
